evidence_policy: Only adopted directly opened primary publisher pages/PDF are counted. These are 17 source URLs, not 17 independent institutions; several come from the same brand or salon chain. No source-image pixel inspection or video playback claimed.

sources.title: Home Haircutting Made Simple
sources.evidence_locator: PDF page 35 (zero based), printed page 33, Crew Cut; pages 32–33 self-cut example
supported_claims: Crew: sides very short; top length varies and generally follows the head shape. Buzz is separately named in the self-cut example.
limitations: Older undated manual; guard examples are a specific tutorial, not universal numeric style thresholds. Tools and cutting order cannot be recovered from a finished photograph.

sources.title: Just Shave It: 10 Buzz Cut Hairstyles For Men
sources.evidence_locator: What Is a Buzz Cut?; entries 1–7 and 9–10
supported_claims: Buzz usually has very short, approximately uniform length; this guide also names faded, disconnected, crew/buzz, line-up and hard-part combinations.
Crew example keeps cropped top length over shorter back/sides. Hard-part examples vary width.
limitations: Source uses buzz as both a classic style and a broad family, so exclusivity with crew/fade/disconnection is not justified. Historical, face-shape and gender-marketing statements are not adopted.

sources.title: How to Do a Flat Top Haircut: The Technique for a Level Crown
sources.evidence_locator: Opening definition; steps 1–4; FAQ What is a flat top / What is a flat top with a fade called
supported_claims: Flat top: upright top hair forms a level horizontal surface; side taper/fade and top height are separately variable.
The FAQ names a tall flat-top fade as hi-top fade.
limitations: Private provider explicitly does not offer Ontario apprenticeship hours/qualification pathways. Its hi-top wording is one provider convention, not an exhaustive universal high-top taxonomy. Numeric height and maintenance advice not adopted. Source image is stock-linked and was not inspected.

sources.title: Step By Step Guide To Flat Top Haircut Video
sources.evidence_locator: Public overview; instructor and technical-skills credits
supported_claims: Educator labels a long technical flat top, supporting length variation within the named style.
limitations: Public overview read; paid video and step-by-step member content were not accessed. Listed techniques do not establish that a result photograph used those tools.

sources.title: The Ultimate Guide to Bixie Cuts
sources.evidence_locator: What is a bixie cut?; types of bixie haircuts
supported_claims: Bixie combines pixie and short bob, with shorter textured crown/side layers and longer face pieces. Fringe and parting variants are named.
limitations: Typical length overlaps bob territory. Curl styling cautions differ from L’Oréal; do not encode a curl incompatibility or exact length bin. Search title and dated body can differ.

sources.title: The ’90s Bixie Haircut Is Back and Trendier Than Ever
sources.evidence_locator: What Is the Bixie Haircut?; How to Style a Bixie Cut
supported_claims: Bixie is a bob/pixie hybrid combining choppy voluminous layers with retained bob-like length; straight, wavy and curly versions are named.
limitations: Intro mentions lob-like length while the definition says shorter than bob: no fixed centimetre or anatomical limit adopted. Broad suitability is marketing, not a biological guarantee.

sources.title: Our Favourite Short Haircuts for Women
sources.evidence_locator: Pixie cut; Classic bob; Undercut hairstyle
supported_claims: Pixie typically has cropped sides/back and longer top layers. Undercut keeps very short/shaved side/back regions beneath a longer top.
Bob is a broad ear-to-shoulder family and can be straight or wavy.
limitations: General undercut definition does not explicitly require an unblended junction in every case. Gender framing, maintenance and face-shape suitability are not semantic obligations.

sources.publisher: Ash 練馬店 / 鈴木拓斗
sources.title: メンズ必見ツーブロックの使い回し！
sources.evidence_locator: ツーブロックとは; かぶせるパターン; 見せるパターン
supported_claims: In this salon convention, two-block shortens side hair near the ears without connecting it to longer upper hair. Covered and exposed versions are described; back taper can coexist.
limitations: One Japanese salon convention; no global definition, national origin or fixed length claimed. Product, chemical-safety and appearance-marketing text excluded.

sources.publisher: HAIR MAKE Ash 鶴ヶ峰1号店 / 黄祥一
sources.title: 刈り上げとツーブロックの違いについて！
sources.evidence_locator: Definition comparison of ツーブロック and 刈り上げ
supported_claims: Two-block has an upper/lower step, while the contrasted kariage has a gradual sloping transition. Several short-region length examples are offered.
limitations: Do not translate every 刈り上げ as skin fade. Millimetre examples vary and are not mandatory. Source text references photos; their pixels were not inspected.

sources.title: お客様カルテ〖ツーブロ刈り上げショート〗
sources.evidence_locator: Customer request, proposal and after-case description
supported_claims: A named two-block case combines short sides/back, movement on top and a shaped, tapering nape.
limitations: Single customer case does not require all two-blocks to have the same top styling, nape or length. Source image pixels not inspected.

sources.title: BEAUTYLAB IT HAIR — 투블럭컷 filter
sources.evidence_locator: Cut menu; named two-block entries in results
supported_claims: Korean official catalog uses 투블럭컷 and 소프트투블럭컷 separately from parts, comma/pomade styling, perms and colours. Both short and medium-length cases are named.
limitations: Catalog names establish use and coexistence only; they do not define an exact length step or provide a formal Korean national standard. Linked videos/Naver posts and image pixels were not inspected.

sources.title: Guide to French Bobs
sources.evidence_locator: What is a French bob?; key features; asking the stylist; type variants
supported_claims: French bob is a short bob around cheekbone/jaw/chin with blunt or softly textured ends. Fringe, parting and straight/wavy/curly variants can vary.
limitations: Internal copy varies between one-length and subtle-layered versions; no mandatory fringe, single exact length or unique visual identity adopted. Parisian identity and nationality are not owner properties.

sources.title: The Ultimate Fall Styling Guide: Tools and Techniques for Seasonal Trends
sources.evidence_locator: Fall Hair Trends 2025 bullets: French Bob / Modern Pageboy
supported_claims: French bob is described as jaw-length with soft layering; modern pageboy is named as sleek with movement.
limitations: Modern pageboy mention lacks a complete length/fringe/outline definition. Product suggestions do not prove the tool used in an image. Trend ranking is not adopted.

sources.title: 13 Beautiful 1940s Hairstyles You Can Still Wear Today
supported_claims: Here pageboy denotes smooth strands with inward-curled ends, including medium/long styling.
limitations: This broader historical styling usage cannot establish that every pageboy is a short bob or a bowl cut. English page first failed, then opened successfully via search reference; same brand language mirror also read.

sources.title: How To Make the Butterfly Cut Work for Your Hair Type and Texture
sources.evidence_locator: What Is a Butterfly Haircut?; comparison Q&A; length and layer-placement guidance
supported_claims: Butterfly combines shorter face-framing layers with retained longer layers and feathered movement. Short, medium and long variants are named; fringe is optional.
This page distinguishes butterfly from wolf and octopus styles.
limitations: Copy describes layers as disconnected in one comparison and blended in another, so technical disconnection is not mandatory. Styling-dependent outward bends are not a proof of a cutting tool or natural wave.

sources.title: The Ultimate Guide to Butterfly Cuts
sources.evidence_locator: What is a butterfly cut? and two layer-length bullets
supported_claims: Shorter face-framing layers plus longer retained lengths define the stated butterfly structure. The page also calls butterfly sometimes octopus.
limitations: The octopus-alias statement conflicts with L’Oréal’s explicit distinction. Treat it as search-use evidence, not equivalent semantic identity.

sources.title: The Classic Side Part: Timeless Style Guide
sources.evidence_locator: What Is a Side Part?; Modern Versions; What to Ask Your Barber
supported_claims: Hard side part is explicitly contrasted with a natural soft part and described as a shaved/razored part line.
limitations: One shop’s styling convention; the finished visible channel cannot prove razor rather than trimmer. Profession, masculinity and formality claims are excluded.
